_help.about: (design 6 Oct §ET.2) Which game the project boots into, mirroring movement.json → profile (§AU). torchfire1: the ambient first-person dungeon crawler (scenes/crawler.tscn, scripts/crawler/). torchfire2: the open world (scenes/main.tscn), the game since 18 Oct (design §FX.1, Mike: 'lock it in'; flipped by Claude, chat, as §FX.8 says): the planet, roads, ecology, weather, seasons and the camp simulation. Nothing of the open world is deleted: it still compiles, and every check in tools/ still runs it (they open scenes/main.tscn directly, whatever this says). GAME=torchfire2 (or torchfire1) in the environment overrides this for one run. Restart after editing. §FX (18 Oct): the open world leads again and torchfire2 is the default; torchfire1, the crawler, is parked with everything it built.
